relations: Ophelia 已与 Dante 结为 mate——他是她当初来救的 demon 之一。
她的哥哥曾被关在她亲手造的牢里，如今不再被关押。
她有翅膀但自认不如 River（River 更擅长用翅、更大更重，且曾飞出监狱）。
监狱不再只属于她一人，她不必独自承担。

facts.fact: 我们用车里的餐巾纸清理后回到监狱。
facts.anchor: Eventually, we cleaned ourselves up with a few napkins we found in his car (gross, I know) and went back into the prison.

facts.fact: 午夜过后很久我终于放下双手，站在坏电梯里喘气——拆解完毕。
facts.anchor: It was long past midnight when I finally lowered my hands.

facts.fact: 我说 It's over，又说再没人能伤害我；他答你现在安全了。
facts.anchor: "It's over," I said, still staring out at the hallway. My eyes were burning, just a little.

facts.fact: 我问能否飞出去（River 飞出去过），他说只要我想就行。
facts.anchor: I stared at it for a long moment before looking up. "Do you think I could fly out?"

facts.fact: 我展翅按多年前学的方式扬起，第一次只微微离地又落回。
facts.anchor: I spread my wings, and let out a soft breath before raising them the way I'd learned to so many years ago.

facts.fact: 第三次冲高入空，虽不稳仍本能穿过电梯开口飞进大厅，落地腿颤、无人侧目。
facts.anchor: The third time, I shot higher into the air. I was far from steady, but it was second nature

facts.fact: 两分钟后 Dante 爬出，把我拉进怀里，我深深吻他。
facts.anchor: Dante climbed out two minutes later, and when he pulled me into his arms, I kissed him deeply.

facts.fact: 我们手牵手走出监狱，心还在狂跳——结束了。
facts.anchor: My heart was still beating fast when we walked out of the prison together, hand-in-hand.
